name: doc-review
description: Native Markdown document review window for AI coding agents. Review rendered Markdown, leave selection comments, edit the raw document, and feed the resulting feedback back to the agent.

interface.shortDescription: Native Markdown review window with selection comments
interface.longDescription: Adds a doc-review skill that opens a native review window for Markdown documents. The user can comment on selections in the rendered document, leave document-level notes, edit the raw Markdown, and submit feedback that the agent then applies.
